segments.text: A heavily mutilated boy who Arbitro keeps as a pet.
"The heart stops, the lungs stop, the brain stops. That's all death is, right?"

The Bl@ster champion for Mikasa District, also known as Area Ray. Akira grew up in an orphanage before being assigned to a foster family, then struck out on his own as early as he could. Framed for murder, he joins so he can defeat the elusive Il Re, leader of Vischio, and clear his name. Will he find what he needs in Toshima?
From the digital manual included with r57701
"Let's go home together. No matter what."

Keisuke and Akira grew up together in the orphanage and have remained close — as close as Akira ever gets to anyone, at least. Employed at a factory, Keisuke is a diligent worker who tries his best but has always struggled. He greatly admires Akira, seeing Akira as embodying everything he lacks. When Akira is sent to Toshima, Keisuke follows, hoping to help.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"Hiya! I'm Rin. What about you guys?"
A surprisingly light-hearted Igra participant who shows Akira the ropes. His frivolous manner and delicate features hide unexpected strength and icy determination. He likes to take photographs.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"Hey, don't worry. Just leave everything to me."

A rare Toshima resident who doesn't participate in Igra, instead acting as an information broker. Though he appears easy-going, it's actually quite hard to get a handle on his real agenda. Still, he does seem sincere about wanting to help, and despite his quirks he gives good advice.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"Close your mouth. You look like an imbecile."

A man feared throughout Toshima as the strongest of Igra's fighters. A consummate narcissist and perfectionist, he cares only about proving his superiority, and will cut down anyone who gets in his way. He sees strength as the greatest virtue, and loathes those who fight for pleasure alone.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"Have you experienced... true emptiness?"
A bewildering figure whose path intersects Akira's. His mild manner and appearance seem at odds with Toshima's grim environment. Is he an enemy or an ally?
From the digital manual included with r57701
"May fortune favor you in battle."
The de facto boss of Vischio and the man responsible for Igra. Arrogant and disdainful of everyone around him, he never seen without his garish mask. Very easy to upset.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"Sing pretty for me, will ya? You don't want me to get bored."
Kiriwar's partner, a hedonist who is ruled by his whims. He wields a custom pair of clawed knuckles.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"Think I might smell something. Yeah... the smell of blood."
One of the Executioners, the brutal warriors who enforce the rules of Igra. Wields an iron pipe, and is never seen without a lazy smile on his face.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"I'm the one who's gonna kill Il Re. I won't let anyone get in my way."
An Igra fighter desperate to win at any cost. His determination makes him one of Akira's most dangerous opponents.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"The choice is yours."
The mysterious woman who offers Akira a way out of his murder sentence. She never lets her cool mask slip.
From the digital manual included with r57701
"That's our mission."
Emma's partner. A stern-faced man who says little and is completely dedicated to his job.
From the digital manual included with r57701
A side character present in True Blood.
A new character added in the True Blood releases.
